title: plectranthus urticifolius
intro: Plectranthus urticifolius, commonly known as the Cape Teale, is a flowering plant species in the mint family that is native to South Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus urticifolius include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
